title: Insociable
summary: INSO'CIABLE, adjective [Latin insociabilis; in and sociabilis, socio, to unite.] 1. Not inclined to unite in social converse; not given to conversation; unsociable; taciturn. 2. That cannot be joined

inlines.v: INSO'CIABLE, adjective [Latin insociabilis; in and sociabilis, socio, to unite.] 1. Not inclined to unite in social converse; not given to conversation; unsociable; taciturn. 2. That cannot be joined or connected. Lime and wood are insociable [Not in use.]
